ichimoku_conversion.interpretation: Current cloud uses past data only; no future-filled lagging series.

ichimoku_base.formula: Conversion/base=midrange(n); cloud A=mean(conversion,base), B=midrange(span), cloud shifted forward base bars

ichimoku_a.formula: Conversion/base=midrange(n); cloud A=mean(conversion,base), B=midrange(span), cloud shifted forward base bars

ichimoku_b.formula: Conversion/base=midrange(n); cloud A=mean(conversion,base), B=midrange(span), cloud shifted forward base bars
ichimoku_b.interpretation: Current cloud uses past data only; no future-filled lagging series.

psar.formula: SAR_next=SAR+acceleration*(extreme-SAR), clamped to previous two extrema; reversal resets
psar.interpretation: Trailing trend reference that can whipsaw in ranges.

supertrend.formula: HL2 +/- multiplier*ATR trailing bands; close beyond prior opposite band flips trend
supertrend.interpretation: Trailing volatility-adjusted reference; initialization begins bullish.
